other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand
Applicant must actively participate in state‑level sports
Students up to class 10th are eligible with a recommendation from the school principal
National or international participants and medalists are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides free training and membership for eligible sportspersons across 11 disciplines, with free access for school students up to class 10 and for national/international medalists.
